NCERT Project Staff (SRA/JPF) Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NCERT Project Staff (SRA/JPF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NCERT Project Staff?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and registration for the NCERT Project Staff positions will be conducted on 25 September 2026. Candidates must report between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the SRA post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Associate (SRA) position, candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Physics or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JPF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Project Fellow (JPF) position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRA post?
faq.answer: The salary for the SRA post is Rs. 42,000/- p.m. for NET/Ph.D. holders and Rs. 40,000/- p.m. for Non-NET candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, one recent photograph, ID proof (Masked Aadhaar/PAN Card/Voters' ID), original certificates/documents, and their self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these project staff positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Staff (SRA/JPF) positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Staff (Senior Research Associate/Junior Project Fellow) position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at NCERT, New Delhi, 110016.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for the SRA post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Associate (SRA) post, candidates need to have two years of experience in Research, Teaching, Content development, or any other relevant field.
